name: new_ag_news_benchmark
description: A variant of the AG News topic-classification dataset intended for benchmarking text classification models on news articles. It contains short news articles labeled with topic categories and is used to evaluate single-label news-topic classification accuracy. The dataset is a straightforward supervised text-classification task commonly used as a baseline for NLP model evaluation.
reputation: AG News and its variants are widely used baseline datasets in text-classification research and benchmarking.
